$comment: Tools that irreversible-confirmation.test.mjs would require to confirm an irreversible change (destructiveHint: true, or a registry.json terminal operation) but that have no irreversible path: state why, naming the call that reverses the effect. `exempt` may only shrink: an entry whose tool now confirms as irreversible, is no longer a candidate, or is gone fails the ratchet. `reversibleStatusValues` lists status values that look one-way to destructive-tools.mjs but can be set back on that platform.

exempt.reason: Sets absolute bid values on existing entities; the previous bid is read back by the tool's own pre-read and can be set again with the same tool. No status changes, nothing deleted. Confirmed as reversible (elicitBidChangeConfirmation).
Each item is an amazon_dsp_update_entity update, whose `state` accepts ENABLED or PAUSED only (ARCHIVED is not an update state on the Unified API); every field it sets can be set back.
operationStatus is ENABLED or PAUSED only: each reverses the other with the same tool. Archival is amazon_dsp_delete_entity, which confirms as irreversible.
Overwrites a commitment's fields (name, spend, dates, ids); no status or delete field exists, and the previous values can be set again with the same tool.
`state` accepts ENABLED or PAUSED only (the tool refuses ARCHIVED and points at amazon_dsp_delete_entity); every other field it sets can be set back with the same tool.

Sets absolute bid values on existing entities; the previous bid is read back by the tool's own pre-read and can be set again with the same tool. No status changes, nothing deleted. Confirmed as reversible (elicitBidChangeConfirmation).
Actions are upload, list, get and getActive. upload adds a new rules version; earlier versions stay on the algorithm and can be uploaded again. Nothing is deleted.
Actions are upload, list, get and getActive. upload adds a new script version; earlier versions stay on the algorithm and can be uploaded again. Nothing is deleted.

A stub: Microsoft Advertising Reporting v13 has no report schedules, so it refuses every call without contacting the API (registry.json declares it only because its name marks it destructive).

deleteAssociations removes only the links between extensions and campaigns or ad groups; the extensions are untouched, and setAssociations with the same AdExtensionIdToEntityIdAssociations restores them. setAssociations and getAssociations remove nothing.

Updates existing offline conversions; a later update can set the previous values again. Confirmed as reversible (elicitConversionUploadConfirmation). Nothing is deleted.

Sets absolute bid values on existing entities; the previous bid is read back by the tool's own pre-read and can be set again with the same tool. No status changes, nothing deleted. Confirmed as reversible (elicitBidChangeConfirmation).
Each item is a snapchat_update_entity update, whose status accepts ACTIVE or PAUSED only (symbolicValidate); deletion is snapchat_delete_entity, which confirms as irreversible.
operationStatus is ACTIVE or PAUSED only: each reverses the other with the same tool. Deletion is snapchat_delete_entity, which confirms as irreversible.
status accepts ACTIVE or PAUSED only (symbolicValidate refuses anything else before a write); every other field it sets can be set back with the same tool.

Sets absolute bid values on existing entities; the previous bid is read back by the tool's own pre-read and can be set again with the same tool. No status changes, nothing deleted. Confirmed as reversible (elicitBidChangeConfirmation).

POSTs each item to {entity}/update/, whose bodies carry no operation_status, so it cannot delete; DELETE is reachable only through tiktok_delete_entity and tiktok_bulk_update_status, which confirm it as irreversible.

Refuses operation_status DELETE before any write (updateStatusShapeErrors: DELETE_NOT_SUPPORTED, pointing at tiktok_delete_entity); ENABLE/DISABLE and field updates can be set back. The registry declaration predates that refusal.
Status changes are not update fields here (they go through tiktok_update_smart_plus_status, which confirms DELETE as irreversible); every field it sets can be set back.

Sets absolute bid values on existing entities; the previous bid is read back by the tool's own pre-read and can be set again with the same tool. No status changes, nothing deleted. Confirmed as reversible (elicitBidChangeConfirmation).
batch_get reads; batch_update replaces bid lists' lines with complete BidListUpdateInputs, which a later batch_update can set back. No bid list is deleted (that is ttd_manage_bid_list delete).
Stops an in-flight report run; nothing on the platform is destroyed, and the report can be run again (ttd_rerun_report_schedule, ttd_execute_entity_report).
Cancelling a bulk job stops further work and destroys nothing; a cancelled job can be submitted again. The mutations it may already have run were confirmed when the job was submitted.
Operations are create, update, get, set_default_advertiser and attach_to_campaign: each overwrites or adds, and the previous seed or default can be set again. Nothing is deleted.
Overwrites a schedule's settings; the previous settings can be set again with the same tool. Deleting a schedule is ttd_delete_report_schedule, which confirms as irreversible.
Overwrites a report template's settings; the previous settings can be set again with the same tool. Nothing is deleted.

reversibleStatusValues.reason: LinkedIn reactivates an archived campaign, campaign group or creative: linkedin_update_entity or linkedin_bulk_update_status sets ACTIVE or PAUSED again (both tools' descriptions say ARCHIVED is reversible).
